cohort: 85 women with a history of caesarean delivery and 434 women without a history of caesarean delivery undergoing termination of pregnancy in the second trimester
finding: Low-dose vaginal misoprostol was associated with a higher risk of haemorrhage requiring transfusion in women with a history of caesarean delivery compared to women without, but there was no difference in the success rate of termination or induction to abortion interval.
